content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: prayagraj.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Prayagraj District Court Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Prayagraj District Court Counselor posts is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be graduates in Sociology or Psychology. A Master's degree in Social Work with 2 years of family counseling experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Counselor position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Counselor post is 35 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Counselor post in the Prayagraj District Court recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Counselor post is Rs. 1000 per working day or Rs. 24000 per month, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Counselor role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an application review. Further details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Prayagraj District Court, which is prayagraj.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates as mentioned in the official notification.
